description: This Kotlin source file defines a Jetpack Compose UI component called BannerCarousel, which displays a horizontally scrolling, focusable, and animated banner carousel optimized for TV devices. It includes composable functions for rendering individual banner items with scale and elevation effects when focused, uses Coil for image loading, and handles focus navigation with custom focus requests. The component is highly configurable with parameters for items, focus controllers, and styling, and emphasizes precise centering and spacing for TV navigation.

methods.name: BannerCarousel
methods.description: A composable function that renders a horizontally scrollable banner carousel with focus and animation support, optimized for TV navigation.

methods.name: BannerItem
methods.description: A composable function that renders a single banner item with scaling and elevation effects when focused.
